full_prompt_en: A square luminous digital painting shows a small balcony on an old vine-covered building overlooking a turquoise distant city. The left half is a shadowed facade with tall blue-framed doors and windows, their surfaces partly hidden by dense leaves and dark purple flowers. Near the middle, a narrow projecting balcony with thin iron railings holds a small seated figure, plants, and a few indistinct objects. The figure faces toward the open view on the right; details of the face and clothing are too small and shadowed to identify clearly. Warm orange sunlight catches the balcony slab and parts of the foliage around it. Above, a great spray of fiery orange-red leaves hangs across the upper middle and breaks into scattered marks against the turquoise sky. The right half opens to broad blue-green air, a pale bank of clouds at the far right, and a hazy city of small pale towers low on the horizon. Thick dark greenery fills the lower left, while yellow-green highlights on climbing plants connect the balcony to the brighter sky. The balcony's horizontal ledge and fine vertical rails make a clear geometric pause amid the organic leaves. Light arrives strongly from the right and above, bringing hot color to exposed foliage but allowing the old facade and foliage below to remain cool and deep. The painting uses crisp architectural edges selectively, then breaks them with dappled painterly marks and scattered leaf shapes. The distant skyline is softened by atmospheric haze, adding scale without competing with the balcony. No readable signage appears. The overall composition is intimate yet expansive, balancing a tiny sheltered human moment against saturated sky, warm foliage, and far-off urban depth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形发亮的数字绘画呈现一座旧楼的小阳台，楼身被藤蔓覆盖，阳台俯瞰青绿色远城。左半幅是暗色立面，带蓝框高门窗，表面被密叶和深紫花部分遮住。中央附近，窄小外挑阳台以细铁栏围住一名坐着的小人物、植物和几件模糊物品。人物朝右侧开放景色，脸与衣服因太小又处在阴影里，无法清楚分辨。暖橙日光照亮阳台板及周边部分枝叶。上方一大片火红橙叶横过上部中央，在青绿天空前碎成散落色点。右半边展开宽阔蓝绿空气，最右有浅云带，低地平线上是由小浅色塔楼组成的雾化城市。厚深绿填满左下，攀爬植物上的黄绿亮部把阳台连向更亮天空。阳台水平边沿和细竖栏在有机枝叶中形成清楚几何停顿。光从右上方有力照入，给受光叶丛带热色，却让旧立面和下方枝叶保持冷而深。绘画只在部分建筑边缘保持清晰，然后用斑驳绘画痕迹和散叶形打断它们。远城被大气薄雾柔化，提供尺度而不与阳台争抢。没有可读标牌。整体构图既亲近又开阔，以微小受庇护的人类时刻平衡饱和天空、暖叶与远方城市纵深。
style_prompt_en: Luminous digital painting places saturated turquoise and teal fields against fiery orange-red accents and deep violet-green shadow. Small hard-edged geometric passages are partly swallowed by abundant dappled marks, giving structure and organic motion equal weight. Directional sunlight catches exposed edges and leaf-like flecks, creating warm islands inside cool shade. Dark masses frame one side and lower corners, while a broad open color field on the opposite side supplies breathing room. Near details are energetic and textured; distant forms dissolve into pale haze and lighter, smaller marks. Sharp linework appears at selected rails or edges, then breaks into loose painterly clusters, preventing the surface from becoming uniformly rendered. The composition balances a tiny sheltered focal point with expansive negative space and a high-color canopy. The overall effect is idyllic and cinematic, with intense complementary color carrying depth and emotional warmth.
style_prompt_zh: 发亮的数字绘画把饱和青绿与蓝绿色域同火红橙重音、深紫绿阴影对照。小块硬边几何区域被大量斑驳痕迹局部吞没，使结构与有机运动拥有相近分量。定向日光抓住暴露边缘和叶片似的色屑，在冷影内形成暖色岛。深色体块框住一侧和下角，对侧宽阔开放色域提供呼吸空间。近处细节有活力且有肌理；远处形体退入浅雾与更小更浅的痕迹。锐利线条仅在选定栏杆或边缘出现，随后断成松散绘画簇群，避免表面处处同样渲染。构图以微小受庇护焦点平衡广阔留白和高彩顶冠。整体效果田园而有电影感，以强互补色承载纵深与情感温度。
theme_en: A small balcony among dark vines overlooks a turquoise distant city
theme_zh: 深色藤蔓间的小阳台俯瞰青绿远城
name: Sylvain Sarrailh
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
